This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] bodies, with hunched posture, long snouts, and textured [[Color/Legends|green]], almost porous skin. One member of this species, nicknamed [[Lizard boy|"lizard boy"]], worked as a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="EIVG" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> where he encountered the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] after stealing a [[plasma ignition capacitor]] from a young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielding man sparing the alien after dispatching his [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Scavenger (Mos Espa)|accomplice]].<ref name="EIVG" />
